architectural_identity.only_representation_specific_operator: ictal same-channel pre-onset versus interictal within-EDF contemporaneous cross-channel
architectural_identity.A1_input: exact historical 9 descriptors x ABS, DELTA, ZDELTA, LOGR; 36 dimensions
architectural_identity.TF_input: 32 physical-frequency log-power bins on exact A1 2-second/1-second-hop window grid
architectural_identity.fusion: A1 window embedding + alpha * Linear(64,A1 model_dim,bias=False)(TF latent)
architectural_identity.descriptor_reconstruction: Linear(64,9) on TF latent, predicts historical nine ABS descriptors

TF_preprocessing.physical_frequency_centers_hz: 32 geomspace centers from 1 through 120 inclusive; linearly interpolate power on physical FFT axis
TF_preprocessing.frequency_normalization: global per-bin mean and std fit on respective train subjects only; no per-clip normalization

ictal.cohort_folds_queries_labels: exact historical A1; 80-patient development cohort, 5 fixed folds, 65 matched cells, 47-ID fixed-query evaluation
ictal.I0: reuse historical A1 predictions/checkpoints, no retraining
ictal.I1: independent A1-TF training initialized from fold-specific historical A1 checkpoint where provenance matches
ictal.stage1: freeze entire original A1 core; train TF branch, projection, reconstruction and alpha for at most 15 epochs
ictal.stage2_gate: stage1 train-side validation AP >= matched historical A1 train-side validation AP - 0.01
ictal.stage2: if gate passes, freeze A1 window encoder and unfreeze A1 temporal encoder, cross-record aggregator, patient classifier for at most 15 more epochs
ictal.optimizer: AdamW; TF/alpha/reconstruction LR=1e-4, weight_decay=1e-3; upper A1 LR=1e-5; patient batch size 2
ictal.loss: patient-equal weighted BCE, EZ:NEZ=2:1; plus 0.1 SmoothL1 normalized ABS descriptor reconstruction plus 0.5 MSE original-A1 EZ margin anchor on train patients
ictal.selection: original canonical train-side validation AP, earlier epoch on ties; no test-guided selection
ictal.test: one matched fixed-query evaluation after checkpoint selection and code/lock freeze
ictal.bootstrap: exact historical 47-ID paired cluster bootstrap and 20 fixed query repetitions

interictal.cohort_labels_split: exact official Omni Task-2 v2 split, filters, label ordering, train/validation partition and test cohort
interictal.N0: reuse finalized Omni A1 v2 checkpoint/predictions; no retraining
interictal.N1: same A1-TF topology, initialized independently from scratch; no ictal checkpoint transfer
interictal.optimizer: AdamW LR=1e-4, weight_decay=1e-3, patient batch size 2, max 30 inner epochs; train all A1 and TF modules from scratch because freezing a random A1 core is invalid
interictal.loss: patient-equal weighted BCE, pathological:normal=2:1; plus 0.1 SmoothL1 normalized ABS descriptor reconstruction
interictal.selection: patient-equal pathological AP on official-train inner-validation patients; earlier epoch on ties
interictal.threshold: maximize validation Macro-F1 with historical v2 tie-breaks, then freeze before any new official test access
interictal.final_fit: reinitialize and fit all official-train patients for selected epoch count, preserving frozen threshold and train-only normalizer
interictal.bootstrap: paired patient-cluster bootstrap 10000 draws seed42; zero-positive patients are not estimable for ranking

tests_and_interventions.alpha_zero_replay_before_training: max abs logit diff <1e-6 and zero prediction mismatch
tests_and_interventions.interpretation: posthoc exploratory independent training comparison; neither benchmark provides a fresh sealed confirmation
